q: 明天我___有时间，我们下周再去吧。
zh: 明天我没有时间，我们下周再去吧。
py: míng tiān wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān wǒ men xià zhōu zài qù ba
en: I won't have time tomorrow; let's go next week.
why: Even for the future, 有 is negated with 没有. 不有 is wrong, and 明天 does not change that.

q: 姐姐没买那件衣服___。
zh: 姐姐没买那件衣服。
py: jiě jie méi mǎi nà jiàn yī fu
en: My older sister didn't buy that dress.
why: 没买 is complete on its own; adding 了 after the object is the typical error.

q: 爷爷上个星期没去医院___，他说不用去。
zh: 爷爷上个星期没去医院，他说不用去。
py: yé ye shàng ge xīng qī méi qù yī yuàn tā shuō bù yòng qù
en: Grandpa didn't go to the hospital last week; he said there was no need.
why: The visit did not take place, so 没去 stands without 了.

q: 下个月我们___搬家，还住在这里。
zh: 下个月我们不搬家，还住在这里。
py: xià ge yuè wǒ men bù bān jiā hái zhù zài zhè lǐ
en: We aren't moving next month; we'll stay here.
why: 下个月 is in the future and the sentence states a plan, so 不. 没 cannot negate an event that has not come yet as a plan.

src_py: wǒ jiā fù jìn yǒu gōng yuán
zh: 我家附近没有公园。
py: wǒ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu gōng yuán
en: There's no park near my home.
why: 有 is always negated with 没有, never 不有.

q: 昨天下了雨，一点儿也___热。
zh: 昨天下了雨，一点儿也不热。
py: zuó tiān xià le yǔ yī diǎn r yě bù rè
en: It rained yesterday and it wasn't hot at all.
why: 热 is an adjective and 一点儿也 needs 不 even though the day was yesterday. 没热 is wrong.

q: 我爸爸平时___喝咖啡。
zh: 我爸爸平时不喝咖啡。
py: wǒ bà ba píng shí bù hē kā fēi
en: My dad doesn't usually drink coffee.
why: 平时 marks a habit, and a habit is negated with 不. 没 would report one single occasion that did not happen.

q: 菜我已经买好了，你___再去超市了。
zh: 菜我已经买好了，你不用再去超市了。
py: cài wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo le nǐ bù yòng zài qù chāo shì le
en: I've already bought the food; you don't need to go to the supermarket again.
why: The sense is no need, so 不用. 没 only denies a past event.

q: 弟弟昨天没做作业___，老师很生气。
zh: 弟弟昨天没做作业，老师很生气。
py: dì di zuó tiān méi zuò zuò yè lǎo shī hěn shēng qì
en: My younger brother didn't do his homework yesterday and the teacher is angry.
why: The past event did not happen, so there is no 了 after 没做作业.

q: 我以前___知道这家饭馆这么有名。
zh: 我以前不知道这家饭馆这么有名。
py: wǒ yǐ qián bù zhī dào zhè jiā fàn guǎn zhè me yǒu míng
en: I didn't know before that this restaurant was so famous.
why: Even with the past time word 以前, the state verb 知道 takes 不. 没 is the tempting choice because of the past meaning.

s_py: nǐ men xiǎo qū yǒu bù yǒu gōng yuán
zh: 你们小区有没有公园？
py: nǐ men xiǎo qū yǒu méi yǒu gōng yuán
en: Does your neighborhood have a park?
why: The A-not-A question for 有 is 有没有. 有不有 is not Chinese.

q: 他昨天没来___。
zh: 他昨天没来。
py: tā zuó tiān méi lái
en: He didn't come yesterday.
why: 没 already denies the event, so the 了 of completion is dropped. 没来了 would suggest he no longer comes.

q: 今天___冷，你穿一件衣服就行。
zh: 今天不冷，你穿一件衣服就行。
py: jīn tiān bù lěng nǐ chuān yī jiàn yī fu jiù xíng
en: It isn't cold today; one layer is enough.
why: Adjectives are negated with 不. 没冷 is not used to say that the weather is not cold.

q: 他昨天说要来，可是最后___来。
zh: 他昨天说要来，可是最后没来。
py: tā zuó tiān shuō yào lái kě shì zuì hòu méi lái
en: He said yesterday he'd come, but in the end he didn't turn up.
why: It reports that the event did not happen: 没来. 不来 would state a decision or refusal.

src_py: zhè ge zì wǒ kàn dǒng le
zh: 这个字我看不懂。
py: zhè ge zì wǒ kàn bù dǒng
en: I can't make out this character.
why: Cannot reach the result: 不 between 看 and 懂 (看不懂). 没看懂 would say only that it did not happen.

q: 我___会开车，我每天坐地铁。
zh: 我不会开车，我每天坐地铁。
py: wǒ bù huì kāi chē wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě
en: I can't drive; I take the subway every day.
why: 会 is a modal verb and modals take 不 in front of them. 没会 is impossible.

q: 老师说得太快，我听___懂。
zh: 老师说得太快，我听不懂。
py: lǎo shī shuō de tài kuài wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: The teacher speaks too fast; I can't understand.
why: Cannot reach the result: 不 goes between verb and complement (听不懂). 没 cannot sit here.

q: 谢谢你，不过你___帮我拿包，我自己可以。
zh: 谢谢你，不过你不用帮我拿包，我自己可以。
py: xiè xie nǐ bù guò nǐ bù yòng bāng wǒ ná bāo wǒ zì jǐ kě yǐ
en: Thanks, but you don't need to carry my bag; I can do it myself.
why: No need is 不用. 不要 would be a prohibition, which sounds harsh here.

q: 对不起，我___认识这条路。
zh: 对不起，我不认识这条路。
py: duì bu qǐ wǒ bù rèn shi zhè tiáo lù
en: Sorry, I don't know this road.
why: 认识 is a state verb meaning be familiar with, and state verbs take 不. 没认识 is not said for this meaning.

q: 老师问我周末去不去爬山，我说我___去，因为要在家陪奶奶。
zh: 老师问我周末去不去爬山，我说我不去，因为要在家陪奶奶。
py: lǎo shī wèn wǒ zhōu mò qù bu qù pá shān wǒ shuō wǒ bù qù yīn wèi yào zài jiā péi nǎi nai
en: The teacher asked whether I'd go hiking at the weekend and I said I'm not going because I have to stay with Grandma.
why: The answer is about a future plan: 不去. 没去 would say it did not happen.

zh: 这里不能停车。
py: zhè lǐ bù néng tíng chē
en: You can't park here.
why: 不 stands before the modal 能, not before 停车.

q: 我找___到我的钥匙了。
zh: 我找不到我的钥匙了。
py: wǒ zhǎo bù dào wǒ de yào shi le
en: I can't find my keys.
why: Potential complement: verb + 不 + result, so 找不到. 找没到 is not a form.

q: 这条路在修，你们___走这边，请走那边。
zh: 这条路在修，你们别走这边，请走那边。
py: zhè tiáo lù zài xiū nǐ men bié zǒu zhè biān qǐng zǒu nà biān
en: The road is being repaired; don't go this way, please go that way.
why: Telling people not to do something is 别. 不用 means that there is no need to.

zh: 我昨天没去超市。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi qù chāo shì
en: I didn't go to the supermarket yesterday.
why: 没 stands right before the verb 去. The time word 昨天 may come before or after the subject.

q: 过马路的时候，你___看手机。
zh: 过马路的时候，你不要看手机。
py: guò mǎ lù de shí hou nǐ bù yào kàn shǒu jī
en: Don't look at your phone when you cross the road.
why: A prohibition needs 别 or 不要. 没 only denies that something happened.

zh: 爸爸平时不开车上班。
py: bà ba píng shí bù kāi chē shàng bān
en: Dad doesn't usually drive to work.
why: The habit word 平时 comes before 不, and 不 comes right before the verb 开车.

s_py: nǐ men bù shuō huà
zh: 你们别说话！
py: nǐ men bié shuō huà
en: Don't talk!
why: Bare 不 only states that you are not talking. An order needs 别 or 不要.

q: 你___应该一个人走夜路，太危险了。
zh: 你不应该一个人走夜路，太危险了。
py: nǐ bù yīng gāi yī gè rén zǒu yè lù tài wēi xiǎn le
en: You shouldn't walk alone at night; it's too dangerous.
why: 应该 is a modal, so 不 goes before it. 没应该 is not possible.

q: 房间太小了，这么多东西放___下。
zh: 房间太小了，这么多东西放不下。
py: fáng jiān tài xiǎo le zhè me duō dōng xi fàng bù xià
en: The room is too small; all this stuff can't fit.
why: Impossible by nature: verb + 不 + result (放不下). 没 before the verb would say it was not put down.

s: 天还没黑，孩子们还在楼下玩。
s_py: tiān hái méi hēi hái zi men hái zài lóu xià wán
zh: 天还没黑，孩子们还在楼下玩。
py: tiān hái méi hēi hái zi men hái zài lóu xià wán
en: It isn't dark yet and the kids are still playing downstairs.
why: 还没 + adjective is correct when a change has not happened yet.

s: 我小时候不喝牛奶，现在每天早上都喝。
s_py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù hē niú nǎi xiàn zài měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē
zh: 我小时候不喝牛奶，现在每天早上都喝。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou bù hē niú nǎi xiàn zài měi tiān zǎo shang dōu hē
en: I didn't drink milk when I was little, but I drink it every morning now.
why: A past habit takes 不 even with 小时候.

s_py: lǎo shī jiǎng de wǒ bù tīng dǒng
zh: 老师讲的我没听懂。
py: lǎo shī jiǎng de wǒ méi tīng dǒng
en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: A result not reached is 没 + verb + result. 不听懂 is not a form.

q: 我___知道银行在哪儿，你问问那位警察吧。
zh: 我不知道银行在哪儿，你问问那位警察吧。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào yín háng zài nǎ r nǐ wèn wen nà wèi jǐng chá ba
en: I don't know where the bank is; ask that police officer.
why: 知道 is a state, not an event, so it is negated with 不. 没知道 is not a normal sentence.

q: 我妹妹还小，还___会自己洗衣服。
zh: 我妹妹还小，还不会自己洗衣服。
py: wǒ mèi mei hái xiǎo hái bù huì zì jǐ xǐ yī fu
en: My little sister is still young and can't wash her own clothes yet.
why: Even with 还 for not yet, the modal 会 is negated with 不. 还没会 is not said; learners overgeneralise 还没.

zh: 你有没有兄弟姐妹。
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu xiōng dì jiě mèi
en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
why: The question form of 有 is 有没有, never 有不有.

q: 下雨了，我们___想出去逛街了。
zh: 下雨了，我们不想出去逛街了。
py: xià yǔ le wǒ men bù xiǎng chū qù guàng jiē le
en: It's raining, so we don't want to go shopping any more.
why: 想 (want to) is a modal and is negated with 不. 没想 plus the final 了 does not fit.

q: 我爷爷___喜欢住在高楼里，他觉得上下楼太麻烦。
zh: 我爷爷不喜欢住在高楼里，他觉得上下楼太麻烦。
py: wǒ yé ye bù xǐ huan zhù zài gāo lóu lǐ tā jué de shàng xià lóu tài má fan
en: My grandpa doesn't like living in a high-rise; he finds going up and down too much trouble.
why: 喜欢 is a state of mind and takes 不. 没喜欢 is not said, whatever the time.

q: 我们昨天没去公园___，因为下雨了。
zh: 我们昨天没去公园，因为下雨了。
py: wǒ men zuó tiān méi qù gōng yuán yīn wèi xià yǔ le
en: We didn't go to the park yesterday because it rained.
why: In the first clause 没去 is enough. The 了 that does belong is in 下雨了, a changed situation.

q: 我小时候家里___有电视，晚上大家都听广播。
zh: 我小时候家里没有电视，晚上大家都听广播。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou jiā lǐ méi yǒu diàn shì wǎn shang dà jiā dōu tīng guǎng bō
en: When I was little we had no TV at home; in the evening everyone listened to the radio.
why: Not having something in the past is still 没有. The past time word 小时候 never turns it into 不有.

s: 他说他今天不来，所以我们先开始吧。
s_py: tā shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái suǒ yǐ wǒ men xiān kāi shǐ ba
zh: 他说他今天不来，所以我们先开始吧。
py: tā shuō tā jīn tiān bù lái suǒ yǐ wǒ men xiān kāi shǐ ba
en: He says he isn't coming today, so let's start first.
why: Today is not over; his plan is not to come, so 不 is correct.

q: 不是我不想帮你，我真的___会修这台洗衣机。
zh: 不是我不想帮你，我真的不会修这台洗衣机。
py: bù shì wǒ bù xiǎng bāng nǐ wǒ zhēn de bù huì xiū zhè tái xǐ yī jī
en: It's not that I don't want to help you; I really can't fix this washing machine.
why: The ability verb 会 is negated with 不, before 会 and not before 修. 没会 is not said.

q: 地图上的字太小了，我___看清楚路名，只好问路人。
zh: 地图上的字太小了，我没看清楚路名，只好问路人。
py: dì tú shàng de zì tài xiǎo le wǒ méi kàn qīng chu lù míng zhǐ hǎo wèn lù rén
en: The writing on the map was too small and I couldn't make out the street name, so I had to ask a passer-by.
why: A result not achieved on one occasion: 没看清楚. 不看清楚 as a plain statement is wrong.

s_py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le
zh: 我们好久没见面了。
py: wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn miàn le
en: We haven't seen each other for ages.
why: 好久没...了 is a correct pattern: the time since something last happened. It does not negate a completed action.

q: 我___有姐姐，只有一个哥哥。
zh: 我没有姐姐，只有一个哥哥。
py: wǒ méi yǒu jiě jie zhǐ yǒu yī gè gē ge
en: I don't have an older sister, only an older brother.
why: 有 is negated only with 没. 不有 does not exist.

q: 爸爸___在看电视，他在睡觉。
zh: 爸爸没在看电视，他在睡觉。
py: bà ba méi zài kàn diàn shì tā zài shuì jiào
en: Dad isn't watching TV; he's sleeping.
why: The progressive 在 + verb is negated with 没(在). 不在看 is not a normal way to deny an action in progress.

s: 我昨天请他吃饭，他不来，说太忙。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān qǐng tā chī fàn tā bù lái shuō tài máng
zh: 我昨天请他吃饭，他不来，说太忙。
py: wǒ zuó tiān qǐng tā chī fàn tā bù lái shuō tài máng
en: I invited him to dinner yesterday and he wouldn't come; he said he was too busy.
why: 不 about a past moment means a refusal then: he would not come. 没来 would only report that he did not.

q: 我今天早上没吃早饭___。
zh: 我今天早上没吃早饭。
py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang méi chī zǎo fàn
en: I didn't have breakfast this morning.
why: Negating a completed action: 没 comes in and 了 goes out.

q: 我弟弟从来___去过动物园，所以很想去。
zh: 我弟弟从来没去过动物园，所以很想去。
py: wǒ dì di cóng lái méi qù guo dòng wù yuán suǒ yǐ hěn xiǎng qù
en: My younger brother has never been to the zoo, so he really wants to go.
why: 从来没 + verb + 过 states an experience never had. 从来不 + 过 is not possible.

q: 妈妈没给我买那个玩具___，所以我很不高兴。
zh: 妈妈没给我买那个玩具，所以我很不高兴。
py: mā ma méi gěi wǒ mǎi nà ge wán jù suǒ yǐ wǒ hěn bù gāo xìng
en: Mom didn't buy me that toy, so I'm unhappy.
why: 没 negates the completed purchase, so 了 must not be added.

s: 你不用来接我，我自己坐地铁回去。
s_py: nǐ bù yòng lái jiē wǒ wǒ zì jǐ zuò dì tiě huí qù
zh: 你不用来接我，我自己坐地铁回去。
py: nǐ bù yòng lái jiē wǒ wǒ zì jǐ zuò dì tiě huí qù
en: You don't need to pick me up; I'll take the subway home.
why: 不用 means there is no need to and is correct here.

q: 这个房间___大，住三个人有点儿挤。
zh: 这个房间不大，住三个人有点儿挤。
py: zhè ge fáng jiān bù dà zhù sān gè rén yǒu diǎn r jǐ
en: This room isn't big; three people would be a bit cramped.
why: A quality of the room is described with an adjective, so 不 is required. 没大 does not exist.

q: 我给姐姐打了好几次电话，她都___接，可能在开会。
zh: 我给姐姐打了好几次电话，她都没接，可能在开会。
py: wǒ gěi jiě jie dǎ le hǎo jǐ cì diàn huà tā dōu méi jiē kě néng zài kāi huì
en: I called my sister several times and she didn't pick up; she may be in a meeting.
why: The calls already happened and each time she did not answer: 没. 不接 would mean she refuses to pick up.

q: 我昨天___找到那家饭馆，所以只好回家做饭。
zh: 我昨天没找到那家饭馆，所以只好回家做饭。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi zhǎo dào nà jiā fàn guǎn suǒ yǐ zhǐ hǎo huí jiā zuò fàn
en: I didn't find that restaurant yesterday, so I had to go home and cook.
why: A past result not reached: 没 + verb + result. 不找到 is not a form for a plain past statement.

q: 周末我们一般___在家吃饭，常常去饭馆。
zh: 周末我们一般不在家吃饭，常常去饭馆。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men yī bān bù zài jiā chī fàn cháng cháng qù fàn guǎn
en: We usually don't eat at home on weekends; we often go to restaurants.
why: 一般 and 常常 describe a routine, so the negative is 不. 没 would describe one particular weekend.

q: 因为早上地铁太挤，我下周开始___坐地铁上班了，改骑自行车。
zh: 因为早上地铁太挤，我下周开始不坐地铁上班了，改骑自行车。
py: yīn wèi zǎo shang dì tiě tài jǐ wǒ xià zhōu kāi shǐ bù zuò dì tiě shàng bān le gǎi qí zì xíng chē
en: Because the subway is too crowded in the morning, from next week I won't take it to work; I'll cycle instead.
why: 下周开始 sets a new routine from next week, so 不...了. 没 would claim the subway was not taken in the past.

q: 我哥哥昨天___回家。
zh: 我哥哥昨天没回家。
py: wǒ gē ge zuó tiān méi huí jiā
en: My older brother didn't come home yesterday.
why: A specific event yesterday that did not happen takes 没. 不回家 would mean he refuses or does not plan to.

q: 作业太多了，我今天晚上做___完。
zh: 作业太多了，我今天晚上做不完。
py: zuò yè tài duō le wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shang zuò bù wán
en: There's so much homework; I can't finish it tonight.
why: Tonight has not happened yet and the point is inability, so 做不完. 没 cannot go inside the verb and result.

zh: 他说他明天不来。
py: tā shuō tā míng tiān bù lái
en: He says he isn't coming tomorrow.
why: 明天 is the future, so 不 goes before 来. The subject and 明天 can swap.

q: 上个星期我们___出门，一直在家休息。
zh: 上个星期我们没出门，一直在家休息。
py: shàng ge xīng qī wǒ men méi chū mén yī zhí zài jiā xiū xi
en: We didn't go out last week; we rested at home the whole time.
why: 上个星期 is a finished period in which going out did not happen: 没. 不出门 would describe a rule or a refusal.

q: 这条街上___有银行，只有一家小超市。
zh: 这条街上没有银行，只有一家小超市。
py: zhè tiáo jiē shang méi yǒu yín háng zhǐ yǒu yī jiā xiǎo chāo shì
en: There's no bank on this street, only a small supermarket.
why: Existence of a bank is denied with 没有. 不有 is not Chinese.

q: 我哥哥平时很少坐公交车，今天也___坐，是开车去的。
zh: 我哥哥平时很少坐公交车，今天也没坐，是开车去的。
py: wǒ gē ge píng shí hěn shǎo zuò gōng jiāo chē jīn tiān yě méi zuò shì kāi chē qù de
en: My brother rarely takes the bus, and today he didn't take it either; he drove.
why: 是...的 shows today is over, so 没坐 reports what did not happen. 不 describes the habit, not this day.

q: 虽然朋友们都去了，但是我因为要照顾奶奶，所以没去___。
zh: 虽然朋友们都去了，但是我因为要照顾奶奶，所以没去。
py: suī rán péng you men dōu qù le dàn shì wǒ yīn wèi yào zhào gù nǎi nai suǒ yǐ méi qù
en: Although my friends all went, I didn't go because I had to look after Grandma.
why: 是 contrast: 都去了 has 了 for a completed action, 没去 has none. Do not copy the 了 into the negative.

q: 我___去过上海，你呢？
zh: 我没去过上海，你呢？
py: wǒ méi qù guo shàng hǎi nǐ ne
en: I've never been to Shanghai. What about you?
why: Verb + 过 about experience is always negated with 没, and 过 stays. 不去过 is a classic error.

q: 这个字我___看懂，你能教我吗？
zh: 这个字我没看懂，你能教我吗？
py: zhè ge zì wǒ méi kàn dǒng nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma
en: I didn't understand this character; can you teach me?
why: The result was not reached: 没 + verb + result. 我不看懂 is a typical error.

zh: 我从来不在床上吃东西。
py: wǒ cóng lái bù zài chuáng shang chī dōng xi
en: I never eat in bed.
why: 从来不 states a standing habit, and 不 stays before the verb. 在床上 may come before or after 从来不.

src_py: nǐ zài jiào shì lǐ chī dōng xi
zh: 你别在教室里吃东西。
py: nǐ bié zài jiào shì lǐ chī dōng xi
en: Don't eat in the classroom.
why: A prohibition is 别 before the verb phrase. 不 or 没 alone cannot give an order.

q: 你家有___有电梯？
zh: 你家有没有电梯？
py: nǐ jiā yǒu méi yǒu diàn tī
en: Does your home have an elevator?
why: The A-not-A question of 有 is 有没有. 有不有 does not exist, since 有 is negated only with 没.

q: 太贵了，这个沙发我___买。
zh: 太贵了，这个沙发我不买。
py: tài guì le zhè ge shā fā wǒ bù mǎi
en: It's too expensive. I won't buy this sofa.
why: The speaker decides now not to buy, which is 不. 没买 would say the sofa was not bought in the past.

q: 如果你家附近___有公交车站，你可以走路去坐地铁。
zh: 如果你家附近没有公交车站，你可以走路去坐地铁。
py: rú guǒ nǐ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu gōng jiāo chē zhàn nǐ kě yǐ zǒu lù qù zuò dì tiě
en: If there is no bus stop near your home, you can walk to take the subway.
why: Even in an if-clause, the negative of 有 is 没有, not 不有.

q: 我以后___在客厅吃零食了。
zh: 我以后不在客厅吃零食了。
py: wǒ yǐ hòu bù zài kè tīng chī líng shí le
en: From now on I won't eat snacks in the living room.
why: 以后 looks forward and 不...了 means a new decision to stop. 没 is about past non-occurrence and does not fit 以后.

q: 在图书馆里___能大声说话。
zh: 在图书馆里不能大声说话。
py: zài tú shū guǎn lǐ bù néng dà shēng shuō huà
en: You can't speak loudly in the library.
why: A rule about what is allowed uses the modal 能 with 不 in front. 没 would say someone did not manage to speak loudly.

s_py: wài pó zuó tiān bù lái wǒ men jiā
zh: 外婆昨天没来我们家。
py: wài pó zuó tiān méi lái wǒ men jiā
en: Grandma didn't come to our house yesterday.
why: A past event that did not take place needs 没.

s_py: wǒ zuó tiān méi xiǎng dào nǐ huì lái
zh: 我昨天没想到你会来。
py: wǒ zuó tiān méi xiǎng dào nǐ huì lái
en: I didn't expect you to come yesterday.
why: 没想到 is a fixed result form (did not think of / expect), so 没 is right here.

q: 弟弟不喜欢吃肉，所以他平时___吃肉。
zh: 弟弟不喜欢吃肉，所以他平时不吃肉。
py: dì di bù xǐ huan chī ròu suǒ yǐ tā píng shí bù chī ròu
en: My brother doesn't like meat, so he doesn't usually eat it.
why: 平时 gives a habit: 不吃. 没吃 would claim he did not eat on one occasion.

zh: 楼下没有超市。
py: lóu xià méi yǒu chāo shì
en: There's no supermarket downstairs.
why: Existence of a place is denied with 没有, placed before the noun.

s_py: wǒ cóng lái bù qù guo shàng hǎi
zh: 我从来没去过上海。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi qù guo shàng hǎi
en: I've never been to Shanghai.
why: Verb + 过 for experience is negated with 没, and 过 stays.

s: 我家的旧电视坏了，现在没有电视了。
s_py: wǒ jiā de jiù diàn shì huài le xiàn zài méi yǒu diàn shì le
zh: 我家的旧电视坏了，现在没有电视了。
py: wǒ jiā de jiù diàn shì huài le xiàn zài méi yǒu diàn shì le
en: Our old TV broke, so now we have no TV.
why: 没有 + noun + 了 is correct for no longer having something. The 了 marks the change.

q: 我___愿意搬到郊区，那里离公司太远。
zh: 我不愿意搬到郊区，那里离公司太远。
py: wǒ bù yuàn yì bān dào jiāo qū nà lǐ lí gōng sī tài yuǎn
en: I'm not willing to move to the suburbs; it's too far from my company.
why: 愿意 expresses willingness and is negated with 不, placed before 愿意 and not before 搬.

q: 今天早上我___吃早饭，所以现在很饿。
zh: 今天早上我没吃早饭，所以现在很饿。
py: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ méi chī zǎo fàn suǒ yǐ xiàn zài hěn è
en: I didn't eat breakfast this morning, so I'm hungry now.
why: 今天早上 is already over and the meal did not happen: 没吃. 不吃 would be a habit or refusal.

s_py: jiě jie zuó tiān méi huí jiā le
zh: 姐姐昨天没回家。
py: jiě jie zuó tiān méi huí jiā
en: My older sister didn't come home yesterday.
why: Denying a completed action takes 没 and no 了.

s_py: tā méi rèn shi wǒ men de lǎo shī
zh: 她不认识我们的老师。
py: tā bù rèn shi wǒ men de lǎo shī
en: She doesn't know our teacher.
why: 认识 is a state verb and takes 不.

s_py: míng tiān wǒ méi qù chāo shì
zh: 明天我不去超市。
py: míng tiān wǒ bù qù chāo shì
en: I'm not going to the supermarket tomorrow.
why: 明天 is the future, so 不. 没 looks back at what has not happened.

s: 我没会做饭，都是妈妈做。
s_py: wǒ méi huì zuò fàn dōu shì mā ma zuò
zh: 我不会做饭，都是妈妈做。
py: wǒ bù huì zuò fàn dōu shì mā ma zuò
en: I can't cook; my mom does it all.
why: 会 is a modal verb and takes 不, never 没.

q: 妈妈还___做晚饭呢，你再等一会儿。
zh: 妈妈还没做晚饭呢，你再等一会儿。
py: mā ma hái méi zuò wǎn fàn ne nǐ zài děng yī huì r
en: Mom hasn't made dinner yet; wait a little longer.
why: 还没...呢 means not yet, so 没. 还不 would suggest that she is not going to cook.

q: 他昨天一整天都___回家，我很担心。
zh: 他昨天一整天都没回家，我很担心。
py: tā zuó tiān yī zhěng tiān dōu méi huí jiā wǒ hěn dān xīn
en: He didn't come home all day yesterday, and I'm worried.
why: The non-occurrence is placed in yesterday, so 没. 不回家 would mean he refuses to go home.

zh: 请别在楼道里抽烟。
py: qǐng bié zài lóu dào lǐ chōu yān
en: Please don't smoke in the stairwell.
why: 别 comes before the whole 在 + place + verb phrase, after 请.

q: 我家附近___有地铁站。
zh: 我家附近没有地铁站。
py: wǒ jiā fù jìn méi yǒu dì tiě zhàn
en: There's no subway station near my home.
why: There is not a... uses 没有, and 不有 is never possible.

s: 这么远，我走不到地铁站。
s_py: zhè me yuǎn wǒ zǒu bù dào dì tiě zhàn
zh: 这么远，我走不到地铁站。
py: zhè me yuǎn wǒ zǒu bù dào dì tiě zhàn
en: It's so far that I can't walk to the subway station.
why: Verb + 不 + result is correct for what cannot be done.

q: 明天我妈妈___去超市。
zh: 明天我妈妈不去超市。
py: míng tiān wǒ mā ma bù qù chāo shì
en: My mom isn't going to the supermarket tomorrow.
why: 明天 is the future, and a plan not to do something takes 不. 没 only looks back at what has not happened so far.

s: 不做完作业不能看电视。
s_py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
zh: 不做完作业不能看电视。
py: bù zuò wán zuò yè bù néng kàn diàn shì
en: You can't watch TV unless you finish your homework.
why: In an if-not sentence, 不 + verb + result is correct.

q: 他___是我哥哥，他是我表哥。
zh: 他不是我哥哥，他是我表哥。
py: tā bù shì wǒ gē ge tā shì wǒ biǎo gē
en: He isn't my older brother; he's my cousin.
why: 是 is always negated with 不 and never with 没, so 他不是 is the only form.

zh: 奶奶不知道这件事。
py: nǎi nai bù zhī dào zhè jiàn shì
en: Grandma doesn't know about this.
why: 知道 is a state verb negated with 不 placed directly before it. Fronting 这件事 is also fine.

s_py: jiào shì lǐ bù yǒu rén
zh: 教室里没有人。
py: jiào shì lǐ méi yǒu rén
en: There is nobody in the classroom.
why: 有 is only ever negated with 没, so 不有 is never right.

q: 宝宝睡觉了，你们___说话了。
zh: 宝宝睡觉了，你们别说话了。
py: bǎo bao shuì jiào le nǐ men bié shuō huà le
en: The baby's asleep; stop talking.
why: An order to stop is 别...了. 不用 would mean there is no need to talk.

src_py: wǒ tīng dǒng le lǎo shī de huà
zh: 我没听懂老师的话。
py: wǒ méi tīng dǒng lǎo shī de huà
en: I didn't understand what the teacher said.
why: A result not reached: 没 + verb + result, and the 了 disappears.

q: 我请他来吃饭，可是他说他___来，因为他太忙了。
zh: 我请他来吃饭，可是他说他不来，因为他太忙了。
py: wǒ qǐng tā lái chī fàn kě shì tā shuō tā bù lái yīn wèi tā tài máng le
en: I invited him to dinner, but he says he isn't coming because he's too busy.
why: He states his decision about the coming meal: 不来. 没来 would report that he did not show up.

q: 这里___可以停车。
zh: 这里不可以停车。
py: zhè lǐ bù kě yǐ tíng chē
en: You can't park here.
why: 可以 is negated with 不 (不可以 = not allowed). 没可以 does not exist.

zh: 他没找到钥匙。
py: tā méi zhǎo dào yào shi
en: He didn't find the key.
why: The unachieved result is 没 + 找到, with 没 before the verb. Fronting the object 钥匙 is also correct.

src_py: dì di mǎi le nà běn shū
zh: 弟弟没买那本书。
py: dì di méi mǎi nà běn shū
en: My younger brother didn't buy that book.
why: The negative of a completed action uses 没 and drops 了.

q: 我在这座城市住了十年，可是还___去过那个公园。
zh: 我在这座城市住了十年，可是还没去过那个公园。
py: wǒ zài zhè zuò chéng shì zhù le shí nián kě shì hái méi qù guo nà ge gōng yuán
en: I've lived in this city for ten years but I still haven't been to that park.
why: 还没 + verb + 过 means has not yet had the experience. 还不去过 is ungrammatical.
